payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about previously reported results in speculation detection and scope resolution, including improvements over these results.

claims.text: Previous work on speculation detection reported results that have been improved by at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution using transformer-based architectures.
The approaches to speculation detection have evolved from rule-based systems to deep learning methods, indicating a significant advancement in the field.
Machine learning techniques previously used included Maximum Entropy Classifiers and Support Vector Machines, showcasing a range of methodologies before deep learning.
